title: Cardinals waive former third-round RB Trey Benson after 2 injury-riddled seasons

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cardinals waive former third-round RB Trey Benson after 2 injury-riddled seasons
sources.description: The Cardinals drafted Benson as the potential successor to James Conner in the backfield, but injuries have cut his career in Arizona short.
